assessment: M101 TMA 02 · Change, approximation and evidence · version 1.0
standard: v1.12; fixed illustrated M101 opening v0.4 calibration
scope: Five questions, 19 labelled parts, 100 marks. Units 4–7 / M101 O1, O5 and O6. Block 2 remains 72 hours; separate TMA allocation remains 6 hours; no integration, series, new experimental work, assessment weighting or learner-record changes.

mathematicalScientific.evidence: 56 private checks: symbolic limits/derivatives, independent explicit-branch verification of implicit derivatives, exact rational hand calculations, domain/candidate/sign checks, related rates and tolerance boundaries, asymmetric floating-point guards, corner one-sided checks, and two fresh Python processes. Worked guide separately reviewed part by part; all criterion totals reconcile.
mathematicalScientific.limitations: Author review with separate computational routes, not independent human moderation.

readerAssessment.evidence: Prerequisites checked against actual released passages and approved map. Questions require only taught methods, supplied geometry and a self-contained sensor model. Method-specific requirements are explicit; part marks and public criteria align with private allocations. Q5 permits a plain-text table, no plot or numerical package, and distinguishes failures from zero. Exact forms, alternative valid methods, error carry-forward and floating-point variability are addressed.
readerAssessment.workload: 15 minutes preparation + 40/65/60/50/90 minutes questions + 40 checking/rerun/packaging = 360. Question time includes attempts and interpretation; feedback remains in the module's existing feedback allocation. Times are estimates, not learner-trial measurements.
readerAssessment.changes: Rejected a draft rule-combination too close to an OU exercise; replaced it with a different composition and conceptual second-derivative comparison. Kept theorem conditions, domain selection and code limitations in assessed work rather than optional material.

visualAccessibility.evidence: 57 semantic MathML expressions, stable question and figure IDs, two captioned figures with text alternatives, and keyboard-scrollable long equations. Ten integrated width/theme cases at 1440/900/640/390/320 px; no horizontal document overflow. Actual question, criteria and handover screenshots reviewed; nested-expression typesetting defect corrected and rerun. Desktop line lengths constrained. Collapsed sidebar made non-overlapping on this assessment only. No-JS navigation, keyboard focus/anchors, and offline copies at 900/390/320 px checked. Private guide rendered separately.
visualAccessibility.offline: Self-contained HTML embeds CSS, MathML, SVG, photograph and reuse notice. No solution, code starter, data download or separate assessment PDF is supplied.

wholeAssessment.evidence: Question progression from local/domain reasoning through method selection to whole-interval conclusions, related rates/local models and independent numerical evidence. All four units sampled; no lesson-end exercise layer added. Public criteria explain evidence and partial credit without disclosing the worked guide. Handover follows TMA01's existing private tutoring process; no upload service, submission record, deadline, threshold or module weighting invented.

releaseChecks.productionBuild: pass; native config loader used locally because reused dependencies are read-only
releaseChecks.baselineWarnings: Existing HTML less-than warnings in older teaching, legacy identity script and bundle-size/externalised-node warnings remain outside this change; no new TMA02 build warning.
releaseChecks.preservation: Earlier teaching sources unchanged except the Unit 7 closing availability paragraph. Generated module/block/assessment/closing navigation updated. Unit 8 remains an outline. Existing unrelated working checkout preserved.

privacy.method: Worked guide, criterion-level answer allocations, model code, output and checks are outside the public checkout in a restricted local directory. Prospective public source and the complete build scanned for private sentinels/assets; search manifest contains only the public assessment route. No private guide or model code is staged or published.

publication: Authorised by user only after local checks and hosted security/test/build/deployment gates. Live verification is recorded separately; this document alone does not claim deployment success.
